admin.title: Public page review
admin.switchOn: Public pages and the directory are open.

confirmBody.approve: The /w/ address opens now and is listed in the directory and search. The owner is notified.
confirmBody.return: The request is returned and the owner sees the reason.
confirmBody.block: The page closes now and the owner cannot reopen it.
confirmBody.unblock: It returns to off; the owner may request again.
